signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> (M : Matroid α) -> (f : α → β) -> (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) -> Matroid β

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The construction is total and well-defined for all valid inputs; no junk-value conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E), (VTask.map M f hf).E = f '' M.E
